THESIS STATUS: WEAKENED
ADJUSTED CONFIDENCE: 65%

OVERNIGHT SUMMARY: Futures reversed overnight with ES up +0.41% despite bearish Asia session led by Nikkei -2.79%. VIX elevated at 31.3 (+0.81%) suggests underlying tension remains, but immediate risk-off momentum has stalled.

KEY DEVELOPMENTS:
• ES futures broke above Friday's close, negating immediate bearish follow-through
• VIX remains elevated above 30 despite equity strength - concerning divergence
• Explosive volatility regime (68.5% confidence) still active - environment remains unstable
• Net GEX deeply negative at -2.45B confirms fragile market structure
• Put wall at 625 aligns with short strike but provides potential support

TRADE RECOMMENDATION STATUS: HOLD WITH CAUTION
TRADE NOTES: Position remains viable but risk/reward deteriorated. Monitor 6440 ES level closely - break above invalidates near-term bearish setup. Consider taking profits if spread reaches 50% max profit (~$2.70 credit). Stop loss if ES sustains above 6450.

DAY AHEAD RISKS:
• Futures strength could trigger short squeeze in explosive vol regime
• Put wall at 625 may provide unexpected support near short strike
• VIX/equity divergence could resolve either direction violently

DAY AHEAD OPPORTUNITIES:
• High VIX environment favors option sellers if volatility mean-reverts
• Negative GEX creates potential for accelerated moves in either direction
• Asian weakness may resurface during US session
